body:
The guarded FP32 estimate with five restoring steps has passed the eight original integrated controls and both complete readers. This is a finite prerequisite result; the original benefit trial remains pending.

Evidence is preserved and pushed at [`9979d990`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/9979d990de483574d3de394b7e35b388b4940d35/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-original-controls), tag `evidence/issue-44-fp32-estimate-restoring-original-controls`. Manifest SHA256: `81b76746db58b4a5d6dd4bd2c9e4b6fcdbd132fb299be5763d37689fb4dd07f5` (207 files).

- All 18 operator commands ran once and closed with exit 0: five fresh producer owners, eight original control owners and two reader owners, plus the three admission/review commands. The original 300-second, 4-GiB RSS and 2-GiB reserve limits were retained. All eight XML reports have zero failures, errors, skips and disabled tests.
- The terminal checks join 24,400 actual input rows to 1,678 unique current inputs, seven output seals, and all three provider mappings for each control by device/inode and owned process birth/session. All 26 observed births are absent. The complete owned temporary inventories were checked against local and Git archive bytes before retirement.
- The original observer, assertions, resources and instrumentation are unchanged. Actual executables contain all 40 main arrays and two owner arrays: 17 main arrays changed, 23 main and both owner arrays unchanged; all seven program tables are retained. The candidate uses the canonical device object and default archive extraction.
- Complete timestamp checks cover 32 readbacks, 51 ordered markers and 54 actual module/command joins across four timed roles and seven selected modules. Four Endpoint routes supply 56 complete readbacks, all exact to the original reference. This does not claim seven distinct execution handles.
- The inherited profile review covers all 35 modules, including 13 named complete helper graphs and four bounded inlined camera footprints. Complete inlined camera normalization, Round and fallback additionally rely on matching source and original O1 scope; no stronger independent emitted-code proof is claimed.

The earlier precontext schema-mismatch attempt remains failed in `795e3d87`; its source admissions are retained. The earlier profile RSS stop remains failed in `45a83f5c`; the separate accepted reader recovery remains `b207cd8a`. Neither failed record was promoted.

Source is still clean, committed and pushed at `4498cc41` on `development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15`, with one worktree. These results do not establish performance benefit, hit rate, production adoption, a frame deadline, full science, hardware-domain or release qualification. The next trial reuses the exact accepted executable pair and the original ABBA order, three repeats per slot, all four whole-call gains >=5%, all sixteen stage gains >=-5%, and both provisioning-inclusive API gains >=0%, without pooling, subtraction or resampling.
scope: Operational issue receipt only, outside benefit freeze and runtime input closure.
